meetings.retranscription_confirm: Processing: {recognition}. Your saved audio stays on this computer. The current transcript will be replaced and kept as a recovery copy. The summary will not be regenerated.
meetings.retranscription_done: The recording has been transcribed again.
meetings.summary_outdated: The transcript has changed. Regenerate the summary to include the new text.
meetings.notes_placeholder: Your notes — Pennel adds context from the meeting later.
meetings.ask_example_this: For example: “What are my action items?”
meetings.ask_example_all: For example: “What did we decide about the budget?” or “When did I last speak with Jan?”
meetings.choose_or_record: Choose a meeting or start recording.
meetings.empty_meetings_help: Start recording. Your notes and transcript will appear here.
meetings.edit_recording_notes: Edit your notes in the recording window until recording is finished.
meetings.choose_text_model: Choose a text model to create a summary.
meetings.share_unavailable: Copy your notes or open the meeting folder to share them.
meetings.no_others_transcript: No transcript from other speakers available.
meetings.download_speaker_model: Download the speaker model in Settings → Meetings first.
meetings.speaker_recognition_help: Recognizes voices with the local speaker model
meetings.conflict_notice: There is a conflicting version of this file.
meetings.source_changed: This source has changed or is no longer available.
meetings.save_before_new: Save the remaining data before starting another recording.
meetings.recording_tracks_help: Pennel records your microphone as “Me” and computer audio as “Others”.
meetings.live_notes_placeholder: Type a few notes… or leave this blank for a summary.
meetings.consent_copied: Consent message copied — paste it into your call’s chat.
meetings.no_system_audio: System audio is unavailable — only your microphone is being recorded.
meetings.delete_help: Notes, transcript and audio will be deleted.
meetings.finishing_pending_one: Finishing recording… {count} part left to transcribe
meetings.finishing_pending_many: Finishing recording… {count} parts left to transcribe

meetings.speaker_cloud_sign_in: Sign in to Pennel Cloud in Settings → Account first.
meetings.download_speaker_models: Download the speaker models in Settings → Meetings first.
meetings.summary_setup_help: Set up summaries and questions to use them in this meeting. Your notes and transcript stay here.
meetings.questions_setup_help: Set up a text service to ask questions about your meetings.
meetings.consent_sentence: I am taking notes with a transcript using Pennel.
meetings.workspace_cadence: Transcript appears as completed speech blocks become available.
meetings.workspace_suggestions_unavailab: Live suggestions are not available yet. Recording, notes and questions work independently. Configuring an experimental connection does not start analysis.
meetings.workspace_sourcecheck_unavailab: Automatic source assessment is not available yet. Open a reference to inspect the original passage.
meetings.workspace_saving_question: Saving notes — question not sent yet.
meetings.workspace_question_save_error: Question not sent. Save your notes and try again.
meetings.workspace_pending: {count} speech blocks are still being processed.
meetings.workspace_source_changed: This source has changed or is unavailable. The excerpt below is the frozen source used for this answer.
meetings.workspace_scope: Only this meeting. Answers use the saved notes and completed transcript at the time of sending.
meetings.workspace_composing: Finish text composition before saving or sending.
meetings.captions_disabled: Live text is off. Finalized speech still appears in the transcript.
meetings.captions_busy: Live captions are paused while speech is processed.
meetings.captions_failed: Live captions are unavailable. Finalized transcription continues.
meetings.captions_unsupported: This provider returns completed chunks of 15–30 seconds.
